name: pane-mod
description: Claude Code's HUD in a side pane (or a band above the prompt, or one line under it): the project, model and effort, usage and limits, context, tasks, subagents and a searchable work log, with a sprite and sounds of your own if you give it some

animate.title: Animate the sprite
animate.description: The sprite moves in every state: working while a turn runs and idle between turns. Turned off, each motion holds its first frame

sprite.title: Show the sprite
sprite.description: Draws the sprite beside the HUD (terminals with the kitty graphics protocol, such as Ghostty, cmux or kitty); turned off, the HUD is text alone. With no frame found in the sprite folder the sprite is left out either way

layout.title: Where the HUD draws
layout.description: auto: a side pane docked beside the transcript where the screen docks one (the fullscreen view, wide enough), the band then holding nothing or one summary row (bandWithPane); the band alone elsewhere. band: the band only. pane: the pane always (above the prompt where the screen docks none). hint: no band and no pane, the HUD in one dim line after the hint under the prompt (/pane-mod still opens the pane). /pane-mod auto|band|pane|hint changes it for the session

bandWithPane.title: The band while the pane is shown
bandWithPane.description: off: nothing, the pane alone holds the HUD. line: one summary row (model, effort, context, 5h, status, subagents)

alerts.title: A line under approval dialogs
alerts.description: Under an open approval dialog, a line saying since when it has waited and the limit warnings standing: the context or the 5h window at 80% or 90%, or the 5h window filling before it resets at the present pace. No toast and no sound: Claude Code's dialogs and warnings, and a terminal's own notifications, already call you

sound.title: Sound on state changes
sound.description: Plays one clip, picked at random, from <sound folder>/<state>/ as the sprite enters that state (working as a model turn starts, idle as it ends); a new clip stops the one still playing. A state with no clip plays nothing. macOS plays it with afplay; other systems play nothing

agents.title: Subagents in the HUD
agents.description: How the HUD shows subagents under its rows. list: one row each (type, task, time, tool calls). summary: one row of counts by state. off: nothing (Claude Code's own task list under the prompt still shows them)

showSession.title: Show the session section
showSession.description: The session rows of the pane's first card (project, branch, mode, turns, style) and the band's first row. A name given with /rename stays on the card either way

showNow.title: Show the now section
showNow.description: Whether a turn runs (a yellow badge with how long it has run) and the tool the main thread runs now: the now rows of the pane's first card and the band's status row

showTasks.title: Show the tasks section
showTasks.description: Claude's tasks (TaskCreate / TaskUpdate, or a TodoWrite list) in a card of the pane: those under way first, then waiting, then done

showModel.title: Show the model section
showModel.description: The model and its effort gauge (and the cost while the totals are off): the first row of the pane's model card and the band's second row

showUsage.title: Show the usage section
showUsage.description: The context gauge, the 5h window with the pace, and the 7d window: the gauges of the pane's model card and the band's third row

showTotals.title: Show the totals section
showTotals.description: What the session has cost and used, summed over every turn (subagents' too): tokens in and out and the share the prompt cache served, in the pane's model card

showContext.title: Show the context section
showContext.description: Memory files, hooks, tools, MCP, skills and commands: counts that seldom change, so off by default. The pane's context card and the band's fourth row

showRecent.title: Show the recent section
showRecent.description: The pane's recent card: the skills and the MCP tools the session used lately, the most recent first, five of each. Nothing shows while there is none

showLog.title: Show the log section
showLog.description: The pane's log card: one line per finished turn, its detail (files, commands, tools, skills, MCP, subagents, errors, approvals, denials), and the file it opens

logTurns.title: Turns kept per session
logTurns.description: How many of a session's newest turns its log keeps (5 or more; 0 keeps every turn). The oldest go first

logSessions.title: Sessions whose logs are kept
logSessions.description: How many sessions' logs are kept, the most recently saved (1 or more; 0 keeps every session's)

logDays.title: Days a log is kept
logDays.description: How many days a session's log is kept after its last save (1 or more; 0 keeps it however old)

paneOrder.title: Order of the pane's lower cards
paneOrder.description: The cards under the pane's first card and model card, top to bottom: tasks, agents, context, recent and log, separated by commas or spaces. A name left out follows in the default order and an unknown name is ignored, so ordering never hides a card (the show settings do). The wheel pages the log only while log is last; elsewhere its buttons and the keys o and n still do

sessionColor.title: First card's color
sessionColor.description: The border of the pane's first card and the session's name. auto: the color /color set, else a dim yellow. Otherwise a theme key (such as claude, subtle, success, warning, error, suggestion, permission, planMode, autoAccept) or a #rrggbb hex, used whatever /color says. An invalid value counts as auto

modelColor.title: Model card's color
modelColor.description: The border of the pane's model card: a theme key (such as claude, subtle, success, warning, error, suggestion) or a #rrggbb hex. An invalid value counts as claude

cardColor.title: Other cards' color
cardColor.description: The border of the pane's other cards (tasks, subagents, context, recent, log): a theme key (such as subtle, claude, success, warning, error, suggestion) or a #rrggbb hex. An invalid value counts as subtle

barFilled.title: Gauge's lit step
barFilled.description: The character every gauge (effort, context, 5h, 7d) draws its lit steps with: one character a cell wide, no emoji, wide character or space. An invalid value counts as the default

barEmpty.title: Gauge's unlit step
barEmpty.description: The character every gauge draws its unlit steps with: one character a cell wide, no emoji, wide character or space. An invalid value counts as the default

spriteSource.title: How the sprite reaches the terminal
spriteSource.description: auto: Ghostty and kitty read each frame's PNG file themselves; any other terminal is sent the PNG data. file: always the path. bytes: always the data (more output per frame, works wherever kitty graphics do)

spriteDir.title: Your own sprite folder
spriteDir.description: A folder holding idle/, working/ and complete/, each with that motion's PNG frames, played in name order (frame_001.png, frame_002.png, ...). Empty: assets/ in the plugin's folder, where none ships. A motion with no frame borrows idle's; with no frame anywhere the sprite is left out and its room goes to the text

soundDir.title: Your own sound folder
soundDir.description: A folder holding idle/ and working/, each with that state's clips (.caf, .wav, .aif, .aiff, .mp3, .m4a, .aac). Empty: assets/sounds/ in the plugin's folder, where none ships. A state with no clip plays nothing
